description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions for handling RLC AM Protocol Data Units (PDUs), including headers and status PDUs, with support for serialization and deserialization, as well as formatting for debugging.

classes.name: rlc_am_status_pdu
classes.description: Class representing RLC AM Status Protocol Data Unit, managing NACKs, packing/unpacking, and control information.

methods.name: rlc_am_read_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Reads and parses the header of an RLC AM data PDU from a byte buffer view, supporting 12-bit and 18-bit sequence numbers.

methods.name: rlc_am_write_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Serializes an RLC AM PDU header into a byte buffer, supporting 12-bit and 18-bit sequence numbers.
